scenario: `scope activation` per LSCP.6.3 — `schema Foo scope activation:` declares an activation-scoped schema, and a rule's RHS asserts a fact of it with an ordinary `emit`; this compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Foo scope activation:
    entity_id: String

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    emit Foo entity_id: t.entity_id
    log info "held"
